name: 案笺
subtitle: 案件、日程与材料的本地工作台
promotionalText: 用时间轴串起案件脉络，把节点、材料、相关人员和收支关联起来。在设备上整理工作，无需注册或登录。
description:
案笺是一款面向独立执业律师及其他案件资料整理者的本地工作台。

案件脉络
按状态查找案件，在时间轴中查看关键节点、待办、日程、记录、材料和收支。为一审、开庭等节点添加属性，关联已有对象或新建对象，梳理案件进展。

材料与文档
通过系统文件选择器导入材料，按案件和文件夹归档。创建文本或 Markdown 文档并预览，给对象添加标签及重要程度。PDF、图片和音频可在应用内预览，材料可导出副本。

录音与转写
点击开始后使用麦克风，录音可暂停、继续并保存为案件材料。iOS 锁屏、后台和系统音频中断会暂停录音，返回前台后可继续。支持的 iOS 设备可在录音结束后转成文字，普通话与英语识别在设备内进行；草稿可编辑后另存，并关联原录音。转写能力取决于设备及所选语言的系统资源。

人员与机构
整理当事人、律师、法院等案件相关人员和机构，记录本案身份并关联其他对象。

费用与日程
记录案件收入、支出、约定费用和凭据，查看收支构成；用日程与待办安排工作。当前 iOS 版本的日程在应用内查看，不提供系统通知提醒。

外观与本地数据
支持浅色、深色与跟随系统，强调色随背景调整。无需注册或登录，案件、材料和录音保存在本机，不上传给开发者；没有广告或开发者云同步服务。本机自动备份不等同于设备外备份，当前 iOS 版本不支持整份工作区的设备外备份导出与恢复。卸载应用会移除本机应用数据。

案笺用于整理用户自行提供的信息，不提供法律咨询或代理服务。
keywords: 案件,律师,材料,日程,待办,工作记录,录音,费用,本地,文件归档,转写,语音转文字

reviewNotes:
Guideline 2.1 — Additional information
App: Anjian (案笺), version 1.7.7, build 25.1.

1. Physical-device demonstration
Video: [PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_URL]
Device / iOS: [DEVICE_MODEL] / [IOS_VERSION]
The video starts on the Home Screen and demonstrates the submitted build.

2. Purpose and audience
Anjian is a local productivity workspace for individual lawyers and case-record organizers. It organizes progress, tasks, documents, recordings, people and expenses. It is available to individuals.

3. Access and main-feature instructions
No registration, login, demo account, activation, subscription, or purchase is required. The UI is Simplified Chinese. On first launch, tap Get started (开始使用) on the welcome screen.
- Open Cases (案件), tap New case (新建案件), enter a fictional name, and tap Create case (创建案件).
- The case tabs are Timeline (脉络), Materials (材料), People (人员), and Expenses (费用). The Timeline combines records and key nodes with custom properties and object links.
- Tap Create (创建) > Key node (关键节点), enter a name such as First instance (一审), and save. Tap any timeline object to view its content, properties and links together. Audio plays inline; the ellipsis menu offers actions. Tap Edit information (编辑信息) to edit tags/importance, then Save information (保存信息) or Cancel (取消).
- In Materials, tap Add materials (添加材料) and choose a file from Files. Files are copied into local app storage. Optional sample: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limushu/new_hm/main/docs/app-store/review-samples/sample-case-notes.txt . Users can also select their own PDF, image, text or audio files.
- Tap Recording (录音) > Start recording (开始录音), allow microphone access, record a fictional sample, finish and save. Audio appears in this case. Recording pauses on background/lock/interruption and can resume in the foreground.
- After recording, tap Convert to text (转成文字); the original is saved first. Allow Speech Recognition. Mandarin/English need on-device support; unavailable models show an explanation. Edit and Save transcript (保存转写稿). Existing audio has the same action.
- In People, tap Add people/organizations (添加人员或机构), choose Person/Court/Judge/Organization, then select an existing local record or create one and add it to the case. The case role is optional. In Expenses, tap Record entry (记一笔) to enter an amount/category; the chart summarizes records.
- Settings (设置) includes the offline Privacy Policy (隐私政策).
User content is private/local. There is no public publishing, community, user-to-user messaging, account flow or paid feature; public reporting/blocking flows do not apply.

4. External services, tools and platforms
Core features use local Tauri/WebKit, React, SQLite and bundled PDF.js. iOS AVFoundation and Files provide audio and documents. Apple Speech performs on-device transcription: support is checked and requiresOnDeviceRecognition is mandatory; there is no cloud fallback. Optional iCloud/Files providers are user-managed. GitHub hosts public support/privacy pages. No external case-data, authentication, payment, ads, analytics or remote AI services are used. Case content and recordings are not uploaded to the developer.

5. Regional behavior
The build has no region-based feature or content gates; the same functionality is provided across enabled storefronts. The UI is Simplified Chinese.

6. Regulated services and content rights
This is a productivity/record-keeping tool. It does not provide legal advice, legal representation, lawyer matching, financial/payment services, or access to court systems, and does not claim court/government affiliation or professional accreditation. Users supply their own records and files. Built-in examples, review samples and screenshots use fictional demonstration material, not third-party case files or licensed databases.
